label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode (trial >= 90)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (0% at GO and D2). 99% of activation mass falls where the reward input is 0 (previous trial unrewarded), and 100% falls at episode trial >= 50, concentrated at the very end of the episode: requiring ep_trial >= 90 keeps 92% of mass and raises precision from 0.04 (ep>=50) to 0.18; ep>=95 gives precision 0.29 but mass recall 0.67. The activations sit at the lowest value-head outputs (94% of mass at value < 5.22), but value adds almost nothing beyond the unrewarded-and-late condition. Magnitude is higher after two unrewarded trials in a row (adding tv(reward,-2)==0: precision 0.37, 61% of mass on 43% of active steps). The feature does not fire after rewarded trials or before trial ~50. Upcoming switch (stay==0) has lift 3.4 but captures only 28% of mass, so the feature is not a switch signal. Predicate uses only observed variables (reward input, plus elapsed time in the episode, which the GRU can only track implicitly). Precision stays low: most late unrewarded D1 steps do not activate it, so it is only partially explained.
